optilens.name: Optilens
optilens.desc: A leading optical company that imports and distributes lenses across 14 wilayas in Algeria.
optilens.solution: We developed and implemented a tailored ERPNext solution to streamline their entire national distribution network. The system centralizes their inventory management, manages complex supply chain operations, and provides real-time visibility across all their regional hubs.

choptic.name: CH Optic
choptic.desc: A prominent wholesaler providing contact lenses and optical products to retailers and clinics.
choptic.solution: We developed custom software to streamline their wholesale operations, managing complex B2B orders and providing real-time inventory tracking for their extensive product catalog.

essilor.name: Essilor
essilor.desc: A global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of ophthalmic lenses and optical equipment.
essilor.solution: We developed a comprehensive tracking and management system to monitor their optical machines and stock via serial numbers, handle client relationships, and automate their sales and invoicing processes.
essilor.h1: Machine & stock tracking by serial number
